brief: A 6s cinematic sting for an isometric glass/chrome letterform. The frame opens black; a soft core glow swells at centre and an anamorphic light streak rakes across the frame. The mark is revealed by that light — fading up from a 1.14 scale with an 18px defocus racking to sharp, so it resolves out of the bloom rather than simply appearing. A specular band then travels across the glass faces, masked to the mark's own silhouette, which is what sells chrome. A slow 5% camera push-in runs under the whole second half, an accent rule sweeps out beneath the lockup, and fine motes drift for parallax depth. Settles to a held hero frame, breathes once, and falls to black.
